description: Risco Hidrológico is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). Polígonos que delimitam áreas de risco de enchentes e inundações em assentamentos precários situados próximos a córregos. A estimativa do número de moradias é feita por setor com base em imagens aéreas, considerando como moradias as estruturas cobertas por telha ou laje. Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Meio Físico, Desastres, geoscientificInformation. The portal shows 2024-12-06 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
